text:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout initiated: svc-search v2.5.0 -> 3% (eu-central). change window 2025-01-18 09:00-11:00 UTC. Watch: p95 latency, 5xx, auth errors. release notes: https://redwood.dev/releases/v2.5.0
arya: heads-up this contains the header-normalization refactor. No DB schema changes.
leo: saw one spike in auth 5xx at 09:03 across 3 canary hosts. raw log sample: `auth.lookup deadline_exceeded 1200ms id=abcd1234`
marta: quick sanity check on staging passed. I'm seeing a header parsing exception in one trace: `UnhandledHeaderError: invalid-charset` - might be related to refactor.
devops: is this tempo correlated with any infra deploys? edge or igw changes?
leo: edge infra green; no config changes. traffic pattern shows a small burst ~09:02 from a single client IP block.
release_manager: recommend soft-hold + pin new sessions to v2.4.9 pending triage. Who volunteers to own rollback if we need it?
arya: I can own rollback. My vote: hold and collect traces. :thumbsup:
leo: +1 to hold. request: aggregate traces and provide span samples for auth.lookup.
deploy-bot: ACTION: pausing rollout at 3%. `/rollout pause 1754000001` - acknowledged.
marta: applying route pin: `rtg pin eu-central v2.4.9` - new sessions will go to v2.4.9; canary instances marked draining.
deploy-bot: routing pin successful. Canary LB now draining.
devops: assigning: @marta debug header parsing, @leo aggregate traces, @arya ready to rollback if needed. Escalation rule: if auth 5xx > 0.7% for next 8m -> rollback.
leo: uploading trace bundle and flamegraphs: https://observability.redwood/trace-bundle/1754000001 (span samples: auth.lookup -> validate_token)
marta: reproduced invalid-charset when client sends mixed-encoding header. quickfix branch created: header-normalize-escape. Running quick staging test.
arya: thumbs: if staging test passes, we retest canary at 1% then ramp. Who thumbs to retry? :eyes:
devops: +1 to retry at 1% after staged fix. Keep pin in place until canary stable for 10m.
deploy-bot: NOTE: pause=success, pin=success, events logged -> /deploys/1754000001/events
release_manager: we'll reconvene in this thread after staging validation. For now: hold = active, rollback owner = arya. Update thread with staging result and a proposed resume command if green.
